chronology_boundary.finding: Al-Alusi accepts the bare Ibn Abbas attribution to Abu Jahl as unobjectionable, but rejects the expanded story tying Abu Jahl to Ibrahim's death because Abu Jahl died earlier.

english_fidelity.scope: English transition from Ata/Abu Lahab to al-Suddi, not a global Ibn Abbas name search.
english_fidelity.finding: The English proceeds directly from the Abu Lahab report to al-Suddi. The intervening Arabic Ibn Abbas/Abu Jahl attribution and adjacent enemy gloss are omitted in this corresponding passage. Ibn Abbas appears elsewhere and is not globally absent.
english_fidelity.policy: Retain Arabic support, separate adjacent reports, and explicit omitted local units.

explicit_absences: No chain accompanies the Ibn Abbas/Abu Jahl attribution in the checked Ibn Kathir or al-Suyuti display.

The separate Ibn Abbas/al-As report and Ibn Abbas/your-enemy gloss are not merged into this route.
